messages:
Nina (marketing): Quick kickoff 9min: we need updated battlecards for the upcoming benchmark post + webinar. Scope: cloud managed endpoints, LLM API providers, infra/tooling vendors. Sales wants short scripts + routing rules for inbound leads.
Omar (gTM): Prioritize: Vertex/SageMaker, OpenAI/Anthropic, Replicate/LambdaLabs. Key buyer signals: SLA/latency asks, on-prem/air-gap, and pricing complaints.
Bea (content): Plan: 1) one-line positioning vs each competitor 2) 3 differentiators 3) 2 objections + 30s scripts 4) routing snippet + owner. Keep each card to a single side.
Evan (sales-eng): Must include "deal signals" and an "escalation" path. Example objection we hear: "We're on Vertex; it's easy for us." Script draft: "Vertex is great for model hosting. If you need deterministic tail latency and predictable per-token economics at scale, Redwood Dedicated + KV caching stabilizes latency and lowers unit cost. We also support private deployments for compliance." Deal signal: mentions p95 spikes or token-cost unpredictability. Route to: AE-enterprise + Solutions-eng.
Maya (product): Benchmarks: we can provide median + p95 latency for 512-token workloads, and relative unit-cost on our Dedicated profile. Legal: no named price comparisons without sign-off.
Nina (marketing): Routing snippet to wire into Intercom/HubSpot (example): ``` if text contains ["latency","p95","SLA"]: tag -> "latency_sla" -> route AE-enterprise if text contains ["on-prem","air-gap","private"]: tag -> "onprem" -> route Solutions-Eng + AE if text contains ["pricing","cost per token","price"]: tag -> "pricing" -> route SDR + pricing-packet link if text mentions competitor names ["OpenAI","Vertex","Replicate"]: tag -> "comp:{name}" -> route based on tier ```
Bea (content): Example concise card for OpenAI/LLM APIs: - Positioning: "Best-in-class model access; Redwood wins on serving predictability and deploy flexibility." - Top differentiators: Dedicated pools + SLAs; KV/prefix caching; Private deployments + KMS support. - Objections: 1) "OpenAI has better models" -> script: "Models are strong; Redwood focuses on predictable serving and cost controls so apps scale reliably." 2) "We use OpenAI streaming" -> script: "We support streaming + function calling with deterministic latency when pinned on Dedicated." - Routing: mention of SLA or pricing -> AE. - Proof point: KV caching reduced repeated-prefix compute by ~X% in internal tests. - Owner: Evan (sales-eng).
Evan (sales-eng): For infra vendors (Replicate/self-host): add "tech checklist" for Solutions-eng: supported GPUs, quantization modes, private install steps, expected throughput. Also add a quick checkbox: "requires air-gap/on-prem" to trigger Solutions-eng.
Nina (marketing): Owners: Bea (content/cards), Evan (sales objections & tech checklist), Omar (routing rules), Maya (benchmarks). Deadline: first drafts by Thu EOD (1713137600).
bot-deploy: Document uploaded: https://drive.redwood/marketing/battlecards/drafts (perm: marketing/view).
Nina (marketing): Good momentum. We will A/B two card templates (technical vs plain language) and measure meeting conversion for 4 weeks post-launch. I'll loop legal about pricing phrases. :rocket:
